findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/resume-store.js::lock released by the publish rename before the stash's own cleanup
findings.title: lock released by the publish rename before the stash's own cleanup
findings.action: Delete the stage's .lock before the publishing rename so no cleanup touches the published store after release.
findings.disposition_rationale: Partly valid. The post-publish unlink of dst/.lock could act on a store a later caller had already replaced; the lock file is now removed from the stage before the rename, and a failed rename removes the stage. The remaining post-release removal of .<issue>.old is kept by design: the spec makes the publishing rename the release, and a second caller can only collide if it completes a full lock, recover, copy and first rename between two consecutive syscalls, then crashes; .old is a backup in that window, not the live store.

occurrences.title: lock released by the publish rename before the stash's own cleanup

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/resume-store.js::carried lists spec-review-hold.json, which restore never restores
findings.title: carried lists spec-review-hold.json, which restore never restores
findings.action: None; the record follows the spec.
findings.refutation: The spec defines carried as every file in the store except hold.json (types block and the DONE item), and the store does hold the preserved prep file.
findings.disposition_rationale: Spec-mandated shape; carried is audit-only and describes the store, not the restore.

occurrences.title: carried lists spec-review-hold.json, which restore never restores

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/resume-store.js::stale-stage takeover loser leaves the winner's stage for 10 minutes
findings.title: stale-stage takeover loser leaves the winner's stage for 10 minutes
findings.refutation: After a takeover the stage belongs to the live winner, which removes it by publishing or on its own fault path; removing it from the loser would break the winner's lock. A crashed winner is the ordinary stale case the spec bounds at 10 minutes.
findings.disposition_rationale: Behaviour matches the spec's lock design.

occurrences.title: stale-stage takeover loser leaves the winner's stage for 10 minutes

findings.finding_id: test/resume-store.test.mjs::staged round check covered only through an injected seam
findings.title: staged round check covered only through an injected seam
findings.disposition_rationale: Under the issue lock the store cannot change between the stashed and staged checks, so no CLI input reaches the staged refusal; the spec names the seam as the way to drive it.

occurrences.title: staged round check covered only through an injected seam
